scope: Later candidate against the qualified, remotely fetched native bootstrap. Source comparison shares dependencies. Controlled Conda profiles exercise independent exact/replacement restoration with the existing native CI artifact; they are not preserved stable releases or full candidate CI qualification. No v0.10.2 compatibility promise is made.

controlled_commands:
set -euo pipefail
root="$PWD/build/validation/bootstrap-350"
python=<ENV>/bin/python
candidate=<CONTROLLED_CANDIDATE>
conda=<CONDA_TOOLS>/bin/conda
for profile in without-examples with-examples; do
    if [ "$profile" = with-examples ]; then
        "$candidate/bin/python" -m pip install --no-deps ./tests/fixtures/packaged_tasks/packages/summary-task ./tests/fixtures/packaged_tasks/packages/report-task > "$root/examples-install.log" 2>&1
    fi
    "$python" tests/compare_runtime.py --conda "$conda" --baseline-capture "$root/ci-runtime" --baseline-kind controlled-artifact --candidate-python "$candidate/bin/python" --candidate-artifact "$root/ci-runtime/gwflow-0.10.2-py_0.conda" --candidate-source fb1979f75dab6943ecb507db258996b14a5ce03c --root "$root/independent-$profile" > "$root/independent-$profile.log" 2>&1
    "$python" tests/compare_runtime.py --conda "$conda" --baseline-capture "$root/ci-runtime" --baseline-kind controlled-artifact --replacement-capture "$root/replacement-capture" --replacement-reason 'Controlled dependency-loss replacement fixture; not an exact original runtime' --candidate-python "$candidate/bin/python" --candidate-artifact "$root/ci-runtime/gwflow-0.10.2-py_0.conda" --candidate-source fb1979f75dab6943ecb507db258996b14a5ce03c --root "$root/replacement-$profile" > "$root/replacement-$profile.log" 2>&1
done
